stack.nuxt_ui: transitive via @narduk-enterprises/narduk-core/nuxt module (no direct @nuxt/ui dep; UIcon/ULink/UInput/UFormField/USelect all in use)

local_reimplementations.name: LevelGauge
local_reimplementations.notes: percent-full fill+waterline gauge with horizontal/vertical orientation and a null-safe 'Not published' state; textbook overlap with narduk-ui's NsLevelWell/NsRangeBar instruments - unverified prop-for-prop but conceptually the same widget (lake level as % of capacity)

local_reimplementations.name: PendingDataPanel
local_reimplementations.notes: icon+label+title+description panel shown when a product/section has no published data yet; same conceptual slot as AppEmptyState (0 consumers app-wide)

local_reimplementations.name: LakeDirectoryRow + lakes/index.vue directory-table
local_reimplementations.notes: CSS-grid header+rows table (.directory-table / .directory-table__header + LakeDirectoryRow, 84 LOC/1 consumer) - see patterns.table; narduk-libs ships no table component at all

local_reimplementations.name: MetricTile
local_reimplementations.notes: NOT a duplicate - already composes NsReadoutTile internally (line 49); good adoption example, listed here only for completeness

table.server_api: server/api/lakes/directory.get.ts (params: q, region, availability, state) - filters the full in-memory directory server-side and returns every match, no limit/offset/page at all

filter_search_bar.notes: UInput search + 2x USelect (region, availability) synced to route.query via router.replace; inline in the page, not a standalone component

freshness_indicator.notes: uses NsFreshnessChip directly - good adoption, 7 NsFreshnessChip call sites total across the app

error_state.notes: '.ls-banner.is-error' inline banner rendered from data?.message, not a shared component

page_header.notes: '.atlas-page-header' pattern (kicker + h1 + description + status chip) reused by class name across pages, not extracted as a component

kpi_stat_tile.notes: composes NsReadoutTile - good adoption, not a gap

card_list.notes: single lake summary card, uses NsFreshnessChip

form_field_patterns.notes: UFormField + UInput/USelect combos for the directory toolbar; narduk-libs ships no form field set component (UFormField itself is transitive Nuxt UI, not a narduk-libs wrapper)

date_time_format.notes: formatObservationDate lives here; not individually measured for LOC/consumers

number_currency_format.notes: formatNumber/formatMetricValue live here (percent, elevation, storage formatting)

layout_shell_nav.notes: app-specific top nav, not narduk-core's Layer* shells (all zero usage)

map_wrapper.notes: composes AppMapKit - correct adoption, not a duplicate

chart_wrapper.notes: no narduk-charts dependency in this repo at all (package.json has no @narduk-enterprises/narduk-charts entry) - this is a fully hand-rolled history chart, not a NardukLineChart wrapper. Strongest chart-family gap found in lane L1.

other.notes: paired with AlmanacStoryPending.vue for the /almanac page; not individually classified

server_list_contracts.response_shape: { ...directory, count, lakes: T[], regions, states } (spread of full directory, not an envelope)
raw directory object, no query params read at all

defect_history.summary: [codex] Repair LakeStat UX and SEO crawl states

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionTable (grid-div variant)
top_extraction_candidates.why: cleanest real table-shaped surface found in lane L1: explicit header row, 5 typed columns, search+2 filters with URL state, row links, empty/loading/error states - but zero sort and zero pagination on an unbounded server response. A shared table component's minimum viable contract should be built from this shape.

top_extraction_candidates.name: NardukLineChart adoption for LakeHistoryChart
top_extraction_candidates.why: this app has no narduk-charts dependency at all, unlike riverstatus - a hand-rolled history chart exists where NardukLineChart would apply directly

top_extraction_candidates.name: AppEmptyState adoption for LevelGauge/PendingDataPanel
top_extraction_candidates.why: LevelGauge duplicates narduk-ui's NsLevelWell/NsRangeBar concept outright; PendingDataPanel (28 LOC/5 consumers) duplicates AppEmptyState's slot

notes: Best narduk-ui instrument adoption seen in lane L1 (7x NsFreshnessChip, 1x NsReadoutTile via MetricTile) even though LevelGauge duplicates NsLevelWell/NsRangeBar right next to correct usage in the same file (LakeDirectoryRow.vue composes both). No narduk-charts dependency at all - LakeHistoryChart is fully hand-rolled. The /lakes directory page is the strongest 'this app actually wants a table' evidence in the lane: real header+rows structure, search+filters+URL-state+row-links+3 UI states, just no sort or pagination because the dataset (Texas reservoirs) is server-filtered but never paged.
